charts.title: TOI-942 c: orbits around TOI-942
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-942's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-942 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Wirth et al. 2021 (2021ApJ...917L..34W), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname WIRTH_ET_AL__2021): P 10.156272 d

charts.title: TOI-942 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-942 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (32, 98, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 146520535, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 29 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 14 min late; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 10 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
